Dr. Sheng Chun Chang

International ZSA educator with multidisciplinary training across Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine.

Zhu’s Scalp AcupunctureClinical educationPharmacyNeuroscienceChinese medicine

Biography

Dr. Sheng Chun Chang is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. His multidisciplinary background spans Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine. His teaching connects classical ZSA theory with biomedical, pharmacological and neurophysiological perspectives while maintaining a strong emphasis on clinical assessment, technique and functional response.
